capabilities: : Run commands from Obsidian and plugins.
extras: Desktop only; installation requires BRAT or manual file placement.
intentEvidence: Inspired by OneNote Style, but deliberately smaller — Markdown formatting only, no OneNote tags, page colours, subpages or AI integrations.
problem: Users need a centralized, highly visible, and customizable command interface similar to Microsoft Office ribbons for quick access to various note functions.

relations.evidence: Inspired by OneNote Style, but deliberately smaller — Markdown formatting only, no OneNote tags, page colours, subpages or AI integrations.
Its whole Excel-style toolbar as the contextual Spreadsheet tab.
Create/edit a task and toggle it done, next to Obsidian's own checkbox command.
Insert a template from the core Templates plugin.
New drawing, embed a drawing, open one, toggle drawing/text.
New base, insert a base, add a view or an item.
Thesaurus: synonym lookup for the selected word, using that plugin's local or online sources.
Check text (whole note or selection) and clear its suggestion underlines.
Format the table at the cursor.
New board, next to New canvas and New base.
A dedicated Git tab: commit and sync, pull, push, commit all, source control, history and fetch.

summary: An Office-style ribbon that provides customizable tabs, groups, and buttons to run commands from Obsidian, core plugins, and community plugins.
